content_zh:
夜已深，茫茫东海之上，波涌连天，四野寂寂。
一艘三层的巨船正劈波而行，船身雕着百子千孙图，描金绘彩，灯笼高挂，远远望去像是海面上浮着一座游动的楼阁。
显然这是艘富贵人家的船。
这船从京城方向驶来，一路南下，绕过江浙，入了东海地界，已在海上行了七日七夜。
行至亥时，海面起了薄雾。
守夜的船工裹紧油衣，嘴里嘟囔了一句：“这雾来得邪性……”
话音未落，雾中便有黑影掠过。
不是一只，是数十只。
那些黑影自浪尖悄无声息地翻上船舷……
桅杆上的灯笼猛地一歪，火光摇曳，在甲板上投下凌乱的影子。
守夜的船工打了个哈欠，揉揉眼睛，恍惚间觉得船尾似乎多了什么。他转头去看——什么都没有，只有黑漆漆的海面和浪花拍打船舷的声音。
船尾的绳索上，正往下滴着水。
但船工没看见。
底舱突然传来一声惨叫——
船工还没来得及转身，一道黑影已落在他身后，他只觉得喉间一凉，便再也发不出任何声音。
血从甲板的缝隙往下淌，汇成细小的溪流，在描金的百子千孙图上蜿蜒而过，将那些嬉戏的童子染成了猩红色。
船上已惨叫迭起，血光迸溅。
底舱的丫鬟婆子们四散奔逃，却被从四面八方涌来的黑衣人截住。这些黑衣人像是从海里长出来的，出手快如鬼魅——刀光一闪，便是一蓬血雾；剑锋过处，便是一具尸身。
青衣少女被三名黑衣人逼到了船舷边。
她不过十五六岁的年纪，青丝散了大半，衣裙上沾满了别人的血。她手里握着一把短匕，是方才从倒下的护卫身边捡的。刀刃上有豁口，映着月光，像一条残破的银蛇。

“小娘子，我们也是拿人钱财替人办事，冤有头债有主，你做了鬼，再去找你真正的仇家索命吧！”为首的黑衣人说道。
少女紧抿着唇，目光扫过身后——下面是翻涌的黑色海浪，像一头张着嘴的巨兽。而前面，是三把淬了毒的刀，刀尖上还往下滴着血。
她没有犹豫，握紧匕首，朝最近的黑衣人扑了过去。刀刃划过那人的手臂，带起一串血珠，但另外两把刀已经同时捅进了她的身体。
一把从肋下刺入，一把从肩胛穿过。
手臂流血的黑衣人，握着第三把刀，当胸直刺，贯穿心肺。
少女的身体猛地一僵，匕首从手中滑落，叮的一声掉在甲板上。
她的眼睛瞪得很大，瞳孔里映着摇晃的灯笼火光，还有头顶那片触不到的星空。
血从嘴角溢出来，温热地淌过下巴。
黑衣人拔出刀，她像一片被风吹落的叶子，无声地坠向海面。
浪花溅起又落下，很快吞没了一切。
……
海面之下，黑暗浓稠得像墨汁。
一条巨大的黑影从深海浮起，它身长数丈，浑身覆满漆黑的鳞片，两只眼睛像两盏幽绿的灯笼，在海底亮得骇人。
这是一条修炼了三百年的海蟒，盘踞在这片海域，以吞噬落水的尸身为生。
对它来说，活人的气息太烈，死人的尸气才最补。一具刚死不久的尸身，魂魄尚未散尽，血肉中还残留着生人的精气，是绝佳的修炼材料。
它闻到了味道。
那股气味从海面缓缓下沉，带着新鲜的铁锈般的血腥，还有一丝极淡极淡的、属于处子的幽香。
content_en:
It was late at night, above the vast East China Sea, waves surged to the sky, and the surrounding fields were silent.
A three-story giant ship is cutting through the waves. The hull is carved with pictures of hundreds of sons and thousands of grandchildren, painted in gold and painted with gold. Lanterns are hung high. From a distance, it looks like a floating pavilion floating on the sea.
Obviously this is a ship belonging to a wealthy family.
The ship sailed from the direction of the capital, went all the way south, bypassed Jiangsu and Zhejiang, and entered the East China Sea. It had been on the sea for seven days and seven nights.
When we reached Hai, mist began to appear on the sea.
The boatman keeping watch at night wrapped himself tightly in his oil coat and muttered: "This fog has an evil nature..."
Before he finished speaking, a black shadow passed through the fog.
Not one, but dozens.
Those black shadows rolled up the side of the ship silently from the top of the waves...
The lantern on the mast tilted suddenly, the firelight swaying, casting messy shadows on the deck.
The boatman who was watching the night yawned and rubbed his eyes, feeling that there seemed to be something at the stern of the boat. He turned around to look - there was nothing there, just the dark sea and the sound of waves lapping against the side of the ship.
Water was dripping from the rope at the stern of the boat.
But the boatman didn't see it.
Suddenly a scream came from the bottom of the cabin——
Before the boatman could turn around, a black shadow fell behind him. He felt a chill in his throat and could no longer make any sound.
Blood trickled down from the cracks in the deck and formed a small stream, winding through the gold-painted picture of Hundreds of Sons and Thousands of Grandsons, dyeing the playing children scarlet.
The ship was already screaming and blood was splattering.
The maids and women in the bottom cabin fled in all directions, but were intercepted by men in black coming from all directions. These men in black seemed to have grown out of the sea, and their attacks were as fast as ghosts--a flash of sword light, and there was a cloud of blood mist; where the sword blade passed, there was a corpse.
The girl in green was forced to the side of the ship by three men in black.
She was only fifteen or sixteen years old, most of her black hair was gone, and her clothes were stained with other people's blood. She held a dagger in her hand, which she had just picked up from the fallen guard. There is a gap on the blade, reflecting the moonlight, like a broken silver snake.
"Little lady, we also use people's money to do things for others. Every injustice has its owner and its debtor has its owner. If you become a ghost, go and seek your life from your real enemy!" said the leader of the man in black.
The girl pursed her lips tightly and glanced behind her - below were the rolling black waves, like a giant beast with its mouth open. In front of them were three poisoned knives, with blood dripping from the tips.
She didn't hesitate, clenched her dagger and rushed towards the nearest man in black. The blade slashed across the man's arm, bringing up a string of blood beads, but the other two knives had already stabbed into her body at the same time.
One penetrated under the ribs, and the other passed through the shoulder blade.
The man in black, whose arm was bleeding, held a third knife and stabbed it straight into the chest, piercing his heart and lungs.
The girl's body stiffened suddenly, the dagger slipped from her hand and fell to the deck with a clang.
Her eyes were wide open, and her pupils reflected the light of the swaying lantern and the unreachable starry sky above her head.
Blood overflowed from the corners of his mouth and trickled down his chin warmly.
The man in black pulled out the knife, and she fell silently to the sea like a leaf blown by the wind.
The waves splashed and fell, quickly swallowing everything.
…
Under the surface of the sea, the darkness was as thick as ink.
A huge black shadow emerged from the deep sea. It was several feet long and covered with pitch-black scales. Its eyes were like two green lanterns, which were horrifyingly bright on the bottom of the sea.
This is a sea python that has been practicing for three hundred years. It lives in this sea area and makes a living by devouring corpses that have fallen into the water.
For it, the breath of living people is too strong, and the corpse breath of dead people is the most replenishing. A corpse that had just died, its soul had not yet dispersed, and the essence of the living person still remained in the flesh and blood, making it an excellent training material.
It smells.
The smell slowly sank from the sea, carrying fresh rust-like blood and a very light, virgin fragrance.
